name: Theodore Roosevelt
role: President of the United States from 1901 to 1909
contribution: The 26th president of the United States, serving from 1901 to 1909.
legacy: As a leader of the progressive movement, this person championed his "Square Deal" domestic policies after taking over as president, which called for fairness for all citizens, breaking corporate trusts, regulating railroads, and pure food and drugs

checks.lead: Theodore Roosevelt Jr. (October 27, 1858 – January 6, 1919) was the 26th president of the United States, serving from 1901 to 1909. A member of the Republican Party and the 25th vice president, he assumed the presidency after President William McKinley was assassinated. Roosevelt was the youngest person to be president, at 42 years old.
